Business Intelligence Developer
Apply Now

Position Summary:
The Business Intelligence Developer supports the day-to-day operations, quality, and delivery of enterprise data and analytics solutions. This role focuses on operational ownership, stakeholder support, and building foundational skills across the BI and data engineering stack while contributing to a cloud-based analytics platform. The position operates under guidance from senior team members with the expectation of growing into technical development responsibilities over time.

Core Responsibilities:
•    Own and manage various support channels (Support Tickets, shared email inbox, MS Teams threads), triaging and routing incoming requests
•    Maintain recurring operational responsibilities (i.e. report subscriptions, data quality checks, and environment health monitoring) 
•    Automate and/or streamline routine tasks including system maintenance, alerting, and cross-team requests
•    Independently perform QA testing on development work prior to release
•    Independently generate release notes and communicate with stakeholders regarding release timelines
•    Contribute to documentation including data dictionaries and process documentation
•    Fulfill ad hoc data requests and support lightweight analysis
•    Monitor solution utilization and evaluate trends over time
•    Assist in scoping and grooming incoming requests, leveraging AI tooling for research and requirements documentation
•    Contribute to development across the team's core technical domains:
•    ETL/ELT and Integration solutions
•    Cloud data warehouse platform
•    Cloud Infrastructure
•    Data Quality and Data Governance solutions
•    Semantic datasets and reporting
•    DevOps CI/CD solutions

Required Experience and Skills:
•    0–2 years of relevant experience in data engineering or related fields 
•    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent experience)
•    Foundational knowledge of data engineering concepts and database systems
•    Functional proficiency in SQL
•    Functional familiarity with Python
•    Technical familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP)
•    Functional familiarity with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau
•    Functional familiarity with Cloud Data Platforms (Databricks/Big Query/Snowflake)
•    Familiarity with traditional programming paradigms (OOP/Functional)
•    Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
•    Effective communicator - comfortable working with both technical teammates and business stakeholders

Role Characteristics:
•    Owns defined operational responsibilities independently while building technical depth
•    Demonstrates curiosity and a willingness to learn across a broad technology stack
•    Works under supervision of senior team members with increasing autonomy over time

Compensation & Benefits

Being a part of IMA has its benefits. When you become part of the IMA family, you become eligible to take part in our valuable benefits and rewards package designed to benefit you, your family, and your life. Our plans are cost-effective, convenient and provide progressive ways for staying healthy, protecting loved ones, pursuing financial security and living a full and balanced life. This role is eligible for the following:
 
Annual Performance Bonus, Stock Purchase, Medical Plans, Prescription Drugs, Dental, Vision, Family Assistance Program, FSA, HSA, Pre-Tax Parking Plan, 401(k), Life/AD&D, Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Long Term Care, Short-term Disability, Long-term Disability, Business Travel Accident, Identity Theft, Paid Time Off, Flexible Work Options, Paid Holidays, Sabbatical, Gift Matching, Well-Being Stipend, Personal and Professional Development.  In addition to our robust benefits package, the final offer amounts will depend on a variety of factors, including the candidate’s geographic location, prior relevant experience, and their knowledge, skills, and abilities. 

*These benefits do not apply to internship roles.
